name: Performance Boost
description: Raises your framerate in levels by switching off costly visual effects, with an optional live FPS and frame-time overlay.

enabled.name: Enable optimizations
enabled.description: Master switch for every optimization below. The FPS overlay is separate and keeps working when this is off.

disable-particles.name: Disable player particles
disable-particles.description: Stops and hides the player's ground, trailing, land, dash, burst, and click particles. Large FPS gain on weaker PCs and phones.

disable-trails.name: Disable trails
disable-trails.description: Hides the regular trail and the wave trail. Wave trails are easy to see, so this is off by default.

disable-shake.name: Disable camera shake
disable-shake.description: Ignores shake triggers. Saves a little work and removes screen shake.

hide-background.name: Hide background
hide-background.description: Hides the level background sprite. Helps on slow GPUs, but changes how levels look.

purge-textures.name: Free unused textures in menus
purge-textures.description: Releases textures nothing is using each time the main menu loads. Lowers memory use, but the first visit to some screens may load slightly slower.

fps-overlay.name: Show FPS overlay
fps-overlay.description: Shows FPS, average frame time, and the worst frame time of the last half second during levels.

overlay-corner.name: Overlay corner
overlay-corner.description: Which screen corner the overlay sits in.
